batch: BATCH 5 — Apify Run Lifecycle & Spend Safeguards Remediation

fixes.description: Moved polling, dataset retrieval, billing extraction, and reconciliation completely inside the for-loop of backend/execute_new_research_run.py. Enforced strict sequence: RESERVE -> LAUNCH ATTEMPT -> START -> SAVE ID -> POLL -> TERMINAL -> DATASET -> BILLING -> RECONCILE -> NEXT PROVIDER. Next provider never starts while previous is unresolved.

In budget_manager.py, recover_orphaned_runs() no longer converts non-terminal or error states to ABORTED with $0 charge. If remote status is RUNNING, READY, unknown, HTTP error (500), timeout, or missing, status is set to NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, maximum reserved amount is held, and future paid runs remain strictly blocked.

Added durable LAUNCH_ATTEMPTED pre-dispatch state. If a crash occurs post-dispatch before apify_run_id persistence, recovery sets NEEDS_RECONCILIATION and preserves the full reservation rather than assuming zero spending.

Added mark_polling_timeout(). If local polling window expires while remote Actor is still running, status is transitioned to NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, full reservation is preserved, and sequence halts without starting the next Actor.
Added ApifyBudgetLock model and _acquire_db_lock() in budget_manager.py using SQLite row-level update serialization. Ensures check-and-reserve is atomic across concurrent worker processes.
